title: The keyboard cannot get around permission or status limits
custom_preconds:
1. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  3. Create a view-only user (skip if one exists):
    • Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create custom role > Skip > Role name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST WO View Only") > tick only View on the Work Orders card > Create.
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Viewer", an email inbox you can open) with that role at the test location, and finish the invite so the user can sign in.
    • Sign this user in later in a second browser or a private window.
  4. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  5. How to create each work order below:
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the customer (add it from the window if it does not exist, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co") and any asset > Create.
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to the technician named (leave it empty for an unassigned one).
    • Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate; approve the estimate for Approved; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing.
    • Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801).
  6. Work orders with lead Ana: "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co" Approved, "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co" Invoiced.
  7. Your dispatcher login (Work Orders create and edit) as well.
  8. The keyboard and focus design is not finished yet (the design shows no keyboard behaviour). Where a step names a key, try Tab, Shift+Tab, the arrow keys, Enter, Space and Escape, and write down which key does what.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as the view-only user, open Work Orders > All, search "ZZAUTOTEST" and click Board View.
  2. Using only the keyboard, move focus onto the Alpha Co card and try every key that could open a menu or move it (Enter, Space, the arrow keys, Shift plus the arrow keys).
  3. Sign in as the dispatcher in the same way and click Board View.
  4. Using only the keyboard, focus the Bravo Co card (Invoiced), reach its more-actions button and press Enter.
  5. Move focus to "Reassign lead technician" in the menu and press Enter.
  6. Try any keyboard move of Bravo Co to Ben's column, then refresh and open Bravo Co to read Lead Technician.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the view-only user cannot open Reassign lead technician or move the card with any key. Alpha Co keeps its place and its lead.
  • Steps 4 and 5: the menu opens, but "Reassign lead technician" is disabled for the Invoiced work order and Enter does nothing. Its tooltip, if you can reach it, reads "The lead technician can't be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid."
  • Step 6: Bravo Co cannot be moved to another technician by keyboard and still has Lead Technician Ana Alpha.
  • The exact keys are still being designed; this case fails only if a key lets the user do something the mouse may not.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10054 (Story 11, Keyboard access and focus); SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S11-N1, S4-N6, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions page 853901313, SQ-15 (Open) and UX-19 (Open). Inline PRD comment by Slavcho Mitrov, 28 Sep 2026, lists what is still open with design. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) Phase 11.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-N1: “Keyboard access must not bypass action permissions or work order status restrictions.”
  • S4-N6: “The disabled Reassign lead technician action on an Invoiced or Paid work order shows this tooltip: “The lead technician can’t be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.””
  • Tech plan Phase 11 tests: “a keyboard-initiated reassign is refused for a locked status and without permission (S11-N1).”
